description: After accepting a secret conditional-amnesty deal from the governor, former train robbers Hannibal Heyes and Kid Curry travel as Joshua Smith and Thaddeus Jones, trying to stay honest while bounty hunters, old associates, crooked businessmen and tempting opportunities repeatedly test the arrangement.

s01e01.description: Former train robbers Hannibal Heyes and Kid Curry try to win a conditional pardon by going straight under the aliases Joshua Smith and Thaddeus Jones, provided they can stay alive long enough for the governor to make the deal public.

s01e02.description: A scheme involving McCreedy and a valuable bust pulls Heyes and Curry into a complicated job where their outlaw reputations remain dangerously useful.

s01e03.description: Heyes and Curry take work in Wickenburg and discover that getting out of town cleanly is harder than arriving under assumed names.

s01e04.description: A train journey toward Brimstone puts Heyes and Curry in the middle of trouble that threatens both their freedom and their carefully maintained aliases.

s01e05.description: A young woman traveling in a boxcar draws Heyes and Curry into a dangerous situation in which helping her may expose more than they can afford.

s01e06.description: Heyes and Curry become entangled in a confidence game where every participant seems to have a different idea of who is fooling whom.

s01e07.description: Returning to Devil's Hole reconnects Heyes and Curry with their outlaw past and the people who still remember exactly who they are.

s01e08.description: A cache of diamonds becomes the center of a shifting contest in which Heyes and Curry must outthink people who are just as interested in the stones.

s01e09.description: A stagecoach trip with a small group of strangers turns into a tense journey as hidden motives and danger begin to surface.

s01e10.description: Heyes and Curry encounter a man whose apparent death hides a more complicated scheme, forcing them to determine what actually happened.

s01e11.description: A seemingly straightforward job involving money and property develops into another elaborate problem for two men trying very hard not to steal anything.

s01e12.description: Heyes and Curry are drawn into a mystery involving a series of victims, where identifying the pattern matters more than their usual instinct to keep moving.

s01e13.description: A journey from San Juan brings Heyes and Curry into another web of conflicting loyalties, money and people who know more than they initially admit.

s01e14.description: An apparently honest man proves that respectable appearances can be every bit as dangerous as an outlaw reputation.

s01e15.description: Charlie O'Rourke's legacy leaves Heyes and Curry dealing with the consequences of an old connection and the people who want what he left behind.
